authority: anyone (declaration only, no body in this file; the selector is dispatched by propose through a low-level staticcall on the owner-set registry address)
reachability: Declaration only: `allowedQuote` (CauldronGovernor.sol:25) has no body here. Its selector is encoded by `abi.encodeWithSelector` (CauldronGovernor.sol:286) and dispatched by `staticcall` (CauldronGovernor.sol:285) inside propose, where a failed call, a short return or a false decode all revert `QuoteNotAllowed` (CauldronGovernor.sol:288). The callee address is the storage slot `registry` (CauldronGovernor.sol:285), so the code actually reached is the registry's public allowlist mapping `allowedQuote` (CauldronRegistry.sol:303), which is written only by the owner-gated `setAllowedQuote` (CauldronRegistry.sol:290) and pre-seeded true for native ether at `allowedQuote` (CauldronRegistry.sol:173).

Runs once at deployment. A zero electorate reverts `EmptyField` (CauldronGovernor.sol:190); otherwise the voting token is frozen into the immutable `mifrens` (CauldronGovernor.sol:191) that every later weight read uses. `Ownable` (CauldronGovernor.sol:189) installs the deployer as owner, and the owner is the only account that can ever wire `registry` (CauldronGovernor.sol:200). The registry is NOT set here, so until `setRegistry` (CauldronGovernor.sol:197) runs the only caller `NotRegistry` (CauldronGovernor.sol:400) would accept is address zero, and a non-native quote in propose staticalls address zero, whose empty return fails the length test at `QuoteNotAllowed` (CauldronGovernor.sol:288).

Owner-only and one-shot: a non-zero current value reverts `RegistryAlreadySet` (CauldronGovernor.sol:198) and a zero argument reverts `EmptyField` (CauldronGovernor.sol:199), so the consumer address can never be rotated or cleared once written to `registry` (CauldronGovernor.sol:200). Whatever lands here becomes the sole caller accepted by `NotRegistry` (CauldronGovernor.sol:400) and the target of the allowlist `staticcall` (CauldronGovernor.sol:285) in propose. Ownership itself is Ownable's: it can be transferred or renounced, and renouncing before this call leaves `markConsumed` (CauldronGovernor.sol:399) permanently unreachable (DERIVED).
observations: comment `markConsumed` (CauldronGovernor.sol:20) says the only privileged call is markConsumed, restricted to the registry; code `onlyOwner` (CauldronGovernor.sol:197) adds an owner-gated setter, and `Ownable` (CauldronGovernor.sol:189) adds transferOwnership and renounceOwnership to the external surface.

authority: voter/holder (any address with non-zero live MiFrens voting power)
reachability: Permissionless for anyone holding one MiFren of live voting power: `getVotes` (CauldronGovernor.sol:240) must be non-zero, with no deposit, cooldown or per-address cap. Input bounds applied here are empty name/symbol `EmptyField` (CauldronGovernor.sol:241), five byte caps `FieldTooLong` (CauldronGovernor.sol:251), a renderer that must have code `BadRenderer` (CauldronGovernor.sol:256), the collection-size ceiling `SupplyOutOfRange` (CauldronGovernor.sol:262) and, for any non-native quote, the registry allowlist `QuoteNotAllowed` (CauldronGovernor.sol:288). `volumePerNFT` (CauldronGovernor.sol:302) is stored unbounded and reaches the hook through `setNftCurveFrom` (CauldronRegistry.sol:1080). The new id is `proposalCount` (CauldronGovernor.sol:291) incremented, the power snapshot is the current block `snapshot` (CauldronGovernor.sol:305), and the vote closes at `votingEndsAt` (CauldronGovernor.sol:306), i.e. three days out. The record is what `winner` (CauldronGovernor.sol:375) hands the registry and what `relaunch` replays via `winner` (CauldronRegistry.sol:849).
observations: comment `markConsumed` (CauldronGovernor.sol:261) says a proposal is untrusted input that must be rejected at this boundary because a deeper revert would freeze the machine; code bounds `nftSupply` (CauldronGovernor.sol:262) and the five strings at `FieldTooLong` (CauldronGovernor.sol:251) but stores `volumePerNFT` (CauldronGovernor.sol:302) unbounded, and it reaches the hook unclamped at `setNftCurveFrom` (CauldronRegistry.sol:1080).

reachability: Unrestricted view. Reverts `UnknownProposal` (CauldronGovernor.sol:317) for an id that was never written, otherwise returns the stored name through the pure library helper `displayName` (CauldronGovernor.sol:318). No state, no value, no reachable side effect.

authority: voter/holder (one vote per address per proposal, weight from the proposal's snapshot block)
reachability: Permissionless per holder. The proposal must exist `UnknownProposal` (CauldronGovernor.sol:331), not be consumed `AlreadyConsumed` (CauldronGovernor.sol:332), still be inside its window `VotingClosed` (CauldronGovernor.sol:337) and not already have this voter `AlreadyVoted` (CauldronGovernor.sol:338); the snapshot block must be in the past `SnapshotNotReady` (CauldronGovernor.sol:343), so a proposal cannot be voted in the block that created it. Weight is the checkpointed balance at `getPastVotes` (CauldronGovernor.sol:344), so tokens moved after the snapshot cannot vote twice, but tallies are cumulative per address because there is no un-vote. This is the only writer of the leader pair `_leaderId` (CauldronGovernor.sol:361) and `_runnerId` (CauldronGovernor.sol:357); ties keep the incumbent because the comparison at `_leaderVotes` (CauldronGovernor.sol:353) is strict.
observations: comment `balanceOf` (CauldronGovernor.sol:15) says the guild votes snapshot-free with weight read live from the MiFrens ERC721 balance; code `getPastVotes` (CauldronGovernor.sol:344) reads checkpointed weight at the stored `snapshot` (CauldronGovernor.sol:343), and `SnapshotNotReady` (CauldronGovernor.sol:343) refuses any vote in the proposing block.

authority: anyone (the registry is the production caller)
reachability: Unrestricted view, but only meaningful to the registry: `relaunch` calls `winner` (CauldronRegistry.sol:849) to build the next brew and later retires it with `markConsumed` (CauldronRegistry.sol:977). Selection is delegated to `_bestUnconsumed` (CauldronGovernor.sol:376), which returns the cached leader only once its voting window has closed; zero reverts `NoProposals` (CauldronGovernor.sol:377). The returned struct copies seven proposer-controlled strings and addresses into memory, which is the replay cost the byte caps in propose bound.

authority: anyone (the registry is the production caller)
reachability: Unrestricted view wrapping the same selection as winner. `relaunch` gates the whole rebirth on it at `hasProposals` (CauldronRegistry.sol:787) and reverts `NoProposal` there when it is false, so a false answer stops the machine being reborn until a settled, unconsumed proposal exists. It costs a scan whenever the cached-leader fast path in `_bestUnconsumed` (CauldronGovernor.sol:395) misses.

Reachable only from the address stored in `registry` (CauldronGovernor.sol:400), which in production is CauldronRegistry inside relaunch at `markConsumed` (CauldronRegistry.sol:977); any other caller reverts `NotRegistry` (CauldronGovernor.sol:400). It re-checks existence `UnknownProposal` (CauldronGovernor.sol:402) and idempotence `AlreadyConsumed` (CauldronGovernor.sol:403), then sets `consumed` (CauldronGovernor.sol:404) one-way. Leader maintenance: consuming the leader promotes the carried runner-up when it is still live at `_runnerVotes` (CauldronGovernor.sol:413), else falls back to the bounded rescan `_recomputeLeader` (CauldronGovernor.sol:419); both slots are then cleared at `_runnerId` (CauldronGovernor.sol:421). Because this call sits inside relaunch, any revert downstream of it rolls the consumption back with the transaction (DERIVED).

Unrestricted view. Copies the whole proposal, five strings included, into memory `_proposals` (CauldronGovernor.sol:437) and reverts `UnknownProposal` (CauldronGovernor.sol:438) for an id never written. No gate, no state change, no value.

Private; reached from `winner` (CauldronGovernor.sol:375) and `hasProposals` (CauldronGovernor.sol:394), hence from the registry's relaunch path. The fast path returns the cached `_leaderId` (CauldronGovernor.sol:450) only when it exists, is unconsumed, has votes and its window has closed at `votingEndsAt` (CauldronGovernor.sol:449); a proposal still taking votes therefore cannot be launched. Any miss pays the bounded scan `_recomputeLeader` (CauldronGovernor.sol:452), and returning zero is what makes relaunch revert.

Private; reached from `_bestUnconsumed` (CauldronGovernor.sol:446) and from the promotion fallback in `_recomputeLeader` (CauldronGovernor.sol:419), so up to three times per rebirth. The window is positional: it starts at `first` (CauldronGovernor.sol:480) and runs to `n` (CauldronGovernor.sol:481), i.e. at most the newest sixty-four ids, skipping non-existent, consumed, and still-open proposals and taking the strict maximum at `bestVotes` (CauldronGovernor.sol:485). Anything older than the window is unreachable by this scan whatever its vote count, which is why consumption carries a runner-up slot instead of relying on it (DERIVED).
